sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eochaid Garbh was the second husband of Tailtiu, the great land goddess. He is the likely founder of the Lughnasa fair at Teltown. Some accounts give that honor to Eochaid mac Eirc instead. The fair carried on in memory of the funeral games held for Tailtiu. His name means rough or coarse, and he guards the borders of the sacred ground.
